name: showreel-11-springs

voice.text: Why do some buttons feel expensive? Same button. Same duration. This one eases in and stops dead. This one springs: it overshoots a touch, then settles, like a real object. CSS does this natively now, with linear(). Chrome, Firefox and Safari have all supported it since 2023. One line. Everything feels more physical.

caption:
Why do some buttons feel expensive? 🫧

Same button, same duration. One eases and stops dead; the other springs: it overshoots a touch and settles, like a real object. CSS does this natively with linear(), in Chrome, Firefox and Safari since 2023.
Save it for your next interface, or send it to whoever builds your buttons.
